instructions.task: Curate cross-medium recommendation links for these TV series.
instructions.why: This dataset becomes a TEACHER (adjacency -> SVD -> coordinates) for a recommender. The cross-medium case (user watches a series -> what film next) currently has NO signal at all: three behavioural sources were tested and all fail (~0%), because a curated link is taste, not behaviour.
what_to_do: For EACH series, choose 4-8 links (a MIX of movies and series).

The 'film' and 'serie' arrays are machine-proposed candidates by shared keywords. Use them as a starting point, but JUDGE them: drop the incoherent ones, keep the good ones, and ADD the ones you know are missing.
Use the candidate ids EXACTLY as given (they are already verified against the catalogue). For your own additions use the 'add' format: type|Title|Year|weight - they get resolved and validated later.
Weights: 3 = strong (the model/obvious companion), 2 = good, 1 = plausible.
Only films/series you are reasonably confident exist with that exact title and year. Anything wrong gets dropped by the validator (and that is fine, it just shrinks the dataset).
Aim for quality, not quantity. A series with only 3 defensible links is better than one with 8 invented ones.
instructions.output_file: Write ONE json file at the path given in 'output'. Same format as this example:
notes: Do NOT modify any other file.
Keep the ids exactly as they appear in the candidate lists.
